request.text: pgustavo's session on WORKSTATION5 created a SYSTEM scheduled task on WORKSTATION6 disguised as a Windows task. Disable account pgustavo.

package.rationale: From an elevated PowerShell on WORKSTATION5, pgustavo ran schtasks /create /S WORKSTATION6 for a task named like a Windows task (\Microsoft\Windows\SoftwareProtectionPlatform\EventCacheManager) that runs cmd.exe as SYSTEM at every start; schtasks connected to WORKSTATION6 over RPC and pgustavo logged on there. The account is being used for remote scheduled-task persistence; disable pgustavo now.
